metas.title: Privacy Policy | Web Audits
metas.description: Privacy policy for Web Audits: strictly necessary cookies only, no tracking, no personal data stored.

body.md_1:
# Privacy Policy

## Cookies & Tracking
We use **HTTP-only cookies** to save your site preferences (e.g. theme or language). No tracking takes place and no third-party analytics tools are used.

## Data Storage
**No personal user data** (such as names or email addresses) is stored in our backend. URLs submitted for audits are processed solely for technical execution. Audit results are stored permanently and are publicly accessible as open data.

## Infrastructure
This website is hosted on AWS. System log data is processed briefly to ensure operational security and is not stored permanently or linked to individual users.
